prompt: What was the purpose of changing how the shoes were laced?
promptZh: 改變鞋帶穿法的目的為何？

options.text: To hold the heels without reducing toe room.
options.zh: 固定腳跟，同時保留腳趾空間。
options.whyZh: 店員用最上方鞋帶孔固定腳跟，且特別說不減少鞋頭空間。

options.text: To give the toes extra room by loosening the heels.
options.zh: 放鬆後跟，讓腳趾有更多空間。
options.whyZh: 腳趾空間不變，後跟要固定而不是放鬆。

options.text: To make the shoes easier to put on.
options.whyZh: 穿法是為了改善行走時的固定，不是為了好穿脫。

options.text: To make the two shoes the same length.
options.whyZh: 鞋帶穿法不改鞋長，店員也沒說兩隻鞋不一樣長。

explanationZh: 店員用最上方鞋帶孔固定腳跟，且特別說不減少鞋頭空間。
evidence: First, try threading the laces through the top holes. That holds your heels in place without taking away room at the toes.

vocabulary.note: thread 在這裡是動詞，表示把鞋帶送過小孔。
